description: Opt-in Renovate automerge for minor, patch, pin and digest updates. Consume alongside the default preset: "extends": ["github>joeyheath65/standards#v1", "github>joeyheath65/standards:automerge#v1"]. Only for repos where merging to main is not a deploy.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch, pin and digest updates merge themselves once CI is green and the release is 3 days old. Majors are untouched and keep dashboard approval. ignoreTests is deliberately unset: a repo with no CI never automerges. platformAutomerge is off so Renovate itself checks CI before merging (no branch protection means GitHub-native auto-merge would not wait).
